 The specified requirements for a winning combination in the base game are also used during bonus features or free spins play unless otherwise stated. Each wager is eligible for all winning combinations unless otherwise stated.

evidence.quote_or_excerpt:
ABOUT THE GAME

 It's Día de los Muertos and we're celebrating the Day of the Dead with a party! Paint your sugar skulls, pick your flowers and grab your bat because we've got 3 Piñatas full of goodies that need to be smashed!

 Join the celebration in Tres Pinatas Hold & Win, a 5-reel, 3-row game with paylines. Land the Piñatas for a max win of {maximumWinMultiplier} times your bet, achievable in all bonus game modes!
